facts: (a) socket: the session's debug log says 'auth line optional here'; the line {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":TEXT}} and a newline, sent without the auth line, started a turn in an idle interactive scratch session (crossSessionInbound accept); the log says 'Routed user message to queue'; nothing is answered on the socket

(b) claude agents --json --all: an interactive session carries status idle|busy and no state; a background one carries state done|blocked|failed and no pid; a background session's process exits after its turn ('[uds-messaging] Shutting down'), so its socket is dead while it is listed done

(c) claude --resume ID --bg LINE continues the session under the same id ('note: woke session ID with its saved options'); with any other flag it starts a copy under a new id ('note: ... started a copy as NEW'); --bg ignores --session-id
